name: kiro-remote-bridge
description: Bridges your kiro-remote-relay to this Kiro IDE window, so you can reply to IDE chat sessions from your phone.

kiroRemoteBridge.enabled.description: Connect to the local hub and deliver remote replies into this window's Kiro chat sessions.

kiroRemoteBridge.hubUrl.description: WebSocket URL of the kiro-remote-agent hub. This is local (same machine as the daemon) — not the Vercel relay.

kiroRemoteBridge.hubSecret.description: Must match HUB_SHARED_SECRET in the kiro-remote-agent .env. Stored in your local settings — keep this machine trusted.
